create_generalized_rcnn_model: create a generalized RCNN model by calling generalized_rcnn with a DetectionModelHelper instance
build_generic_detection_model: build a detection model with a custom conv body and optional ROI box, mask, or keypoint heads
create_rfcn_model: create an R-FCN model by calling rfcn with a DetectionModelHelper instance
create_retinanet_model: create a RetinaNet model by calling retinanet with a DetectionModelHelper instance
add_training_inputs: add training input blobs and a RoIDataLoader to an existing model for multi-GPU training
